findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 NII miss ($0.47 vs $0.5585, citing higher financing costs and tight spreads): stock -14.09% on 2026-07-07 per the baseline; NII-weak prints in the baseline mostly sold (6 of 7 down).
findings.why_not_priced: Public, so partly priced (the stock is at the 52-week low). It is not fully in the price because the drag is mostly in the November-quarter NII, and the first outlook comment on it comes with this print. Financing question answered: the money refinances existing debt, funds no ramp, and the coupon is higher, so it is a cost and not a growth signal.

findings.finding: Sector credit stress (median BDC non-accrual 2.8% in Q2 2026, the highest since 2017, with markdowns accelerating) points to another NAV per share decline from $23.23 for SAR, after a -4.9% quarter that wrote Pepper Palace to zero and marked down Exigo and Chronus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: NAV per share fell $24.42 to $23.23 on 2026-07-07 and the stock dropped 9-14%; 2025-10-07 -4.71% and 2025-05-07 -7.94% were also down on prints.
findings.why_not_priced: The 28% discount to NAV already prices a lot of mark risk; this is sector-level and a proxy, so it is filed at a small weight. SAR's own non-accruals were 0.0% of fair value (1.2% of cost) at 31 May, and core portfolio was 0.2% below cost, which limits the downside.
